card.name: Partway through long medical words
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a longer word split into parts, often after a start such as amin, alk, gar or setmel. It appears in drug, enzyme and chemical names, plus a few ordinary words.

modes.description: The middle piece of a chemical or everyday word split into parts.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long, unfamiliar words, such as enzyme and drug names, while the word is still unfinished.
